response.overview: Saxophonist Geraldo travels to the quiet town of União, in Piauí, to fulfill a promise he made to his grandfather Augusto on his deathbed: to play a song for the souls in the cemetery. Before he can even enter, however, he is approached by Cato, who announces a robbery. After a brief negotiation, Geraldo manages to carry out his mission, but something mysterious happens, and Cato is no longer waiting for him when he leaves the cemetery. Nearby, the sound of music and laughter draws Geraldo to a place where he will experience a night he will never forget.
response.title: O Seresteiro
